name: Job Sequencing with Deadlines
description: Schedule jobs to maximize profit when each job has a deadline and profit. Greedy: sort by profit, schedule each job in the latest available slot before its deadline.
aim: Maximize total profit by greedily scheduling the most profitable jobs first, placing each in the latest available time slot before its deadline.
howItWorks: For each job: find latest free slot ≤ deadline
If free slot exists: schedule job there

time.bestCase: Sort + find slot: O(n log n) + O(n²)

complexity.spaceDescription: Slot array of size max deadline

whenToUse: Unit time jobs with single-machine scheduling
